title: Services Within Prior Authorization Scope, Retro Requests and Admission Notice
content:
**Provider Manual section.** A Prairie Ridge Health Plan Prior Authorization is needed only for services in the class's scope:

- any equipment rental, or any durable medical equipment item priced above the class's equipment price threshold;
- therapy treatment after the initial evaluation, where the class covers the initial therapy evaluation without authorization;
- home health within one certification period of the class's certification-period length.

A retro request for a service already delivered is accepted only within the class's retro request window of the first service date, and an unscheduled admission must be notified within the class's admission-notice hours. Rented equipment becomes the member's after the class's rental months to ownership, and the same item is not replaced within the class's replacement interval in years unless the member's condition changed.

The class settings this section reads are the class's scope thresholds.

## Points of judgement

| Question | Rule |
|---|---|
| Equipment purchase | needs authorization only when priced above the class's equipment price threshold |
| Equipment rental | any rental is in scope |
| Initial therapy evaluation | outside the scope where the class covers it without authorization; treatment after it is in scope |
| Retro request | accepted only within the retro window counted from the first service date |
| Unscheduled admission | the facility notifies within the class's admission-notice hours |
| Replacing the same item | not within the replacement interval, unless the member's condition changed |

## Hypothetical cases

1. In a class with a 30-day retro window, a provider asks for authorization of a service first delivered 20 days earlier: within the window, so the retro request is accepted. Asked 40 days after the first service date: outside the window, so it is not accepted.
2. In a class with a 5-year replacement interval, a member asks for the same item 3 years after the last one with no change in condition: not replaced; with a documented change in the member's condition, the replacement interval does not bar it.
